def quicksort(arr):

    Quicksort – an efficient divide-and-conquer sorting algorithm.

    Strategy:
        1. PICK A PIVOT   – choose one element (here: the last element).
        2. PARTITION      – rearrange elements so that:
                             • everything < pivot is on its left,
                             • everything >= pivot is on its right.
        3. RECURSE        – apply quicksort to the two sub-arrays.

    Time Complexity : O(n log n) average | O(n²) worst case (already sorted input)
    Space Complexity: O(log n) for recursion stack (in-place partitioning)

    Args:
        arr (list): A mutable list of comparable elements.
